title: Deep Or Angle
style: Rock reggae with driving offbeat guitar chops, punchy bass, and a tense half-time pulse; verse pushes with gritty call-and-response phrasing, pre-chorus strips to bass and snare before the lift, chorus hits with gang vocals and clipped hook repeats. Add skanking guitar stabs, tom fills into every section change, a siren swell before each chorus, and a wide, forceful mix with close-mic lead and shouted doubles on the hook., reggae, rock, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Peekaboo, baby, watch the line
First strike starts the whole design
You bring the pace, you choose the zone
Deep in the box or wide and thrown

The first punch lands on your side
Service sets the whole next ride
Then the other team takes their chance
A deep return can break the stance

[Pre-Chorus]
Hit it deep, make room
Push them back, make them move
Hit it deep, make room
Now the point can bloom

[Chorus]
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Win that first exchange
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Set the point to change
Deep return, deep serve
Make them reach, make them serve
Deep or angle, deep or angle
That’s how points get earned

[Verse 2]
If your serve sits short, they jump in
If your return drifts, they take it in
But drive it deep, and watch them fold
Now they’re on the back foot, cold

Angle sharp, or straight and long
Both can make that rally wrong
Serve that bites, return that lands
That’s how you take command

[Pre-Chorus]
Hit it deep, make room
Push them back, make them move
Hit it deep, make room
Now the point can bloom

[Chorus]
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Win that first exchange
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Set the point to change
Deep return, deep serve
Make them reach, make them serve
Deep or angle, deep or angle
That’s how points get earned

[Bridge]
It starts with one
It starts with two
One team sends
The other moves
Same weight, same fight
Same chance to strike
Keep it deep
And own the night

[Final Chorus]
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Win that first exchange
Deep or angle, deep or angle
Set the point to change
Deep return, deep serve
Make them reach, make them serve
Deep or angle, deep or angle
That’s how points get earned
